message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to your account management system, so I can’t directly change your password.  
If you need to reset or update your credentials, please log into your account’s profile/settings page (or contact support) where you’ll find options to modify your password securely. If there’s anything else I can help with—like troubleshooting login issues—I’d be happy to assist!
message.reasoning:
The user wants to "update my credentials" with new password. But we have no tool for updating credentials; only a login/authenticate function exists. There's no mention of ability to change password. We should respond politely explaining limitation.

We can ask clarifying question or suggest they use account settings. Probably best to say cannot do it here.
